name: Heart
description: A heart grows from the center with a little heartbeat to reveal the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Center of the heart (0..1, y down)

params.name: pulse
params.description: Strength of the heartbeat as the heart grows

params.name: glow_color
params.description: Color of the light along the heart's edge

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the glow (0 for a clean edge)
